description_en: Updates the scheduled auto scaling configuration for a service
description_zh: 更新服务定时扩缩容配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun eas update-service-cron-scaler --cluster-id cn-shanghai --service-name foo --scale-jobs TargetSize=2 TimeZone=Asia/Shanghai Schedule=0_18_0_0_0_0 Name=scale-job-1 --exclude-dates 0_0_0_0_0_0,6 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateServiceCronScaler
